title: Mean absolute deviation is bounded by the averaged pairwise difference
statement: Let α be a type with a σ-algebra and μ a measure on it. Let F ⊆ α be measurable with μ(F) = ofReal a for a real number a > 0, and let u : α → ℝ be measurable and integrable on F. Put ū := a⁻¹ ∫_F u dμ. Then ∫⁻_F ofReal|u(x) − ū| dμ(x) ≤ ofReal(a⁻¹) · ∫⁻_F ∫⁻_F ofReal|u(x) − u(y)| dμ(y) dμ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → IntegrableOn u F μ → ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - a⁻¹ * ∫ y in F, u y ∂μ| ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in F, ∫⁻ y in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ∂μ ∂μ
